Description: TBT elevation on 4x throttled mobile CPU (/blog 466ms, /cases 475ms, /faq 395ms)
TriggerCondition: Low-end mobile CPU throttle with heavy DOM trees (>1000 nodes)
ActionTaken: Eliminated premature below-the-fold mounting (rootMargin 120px) and secondary title reflows. Verified mobile TBT dropped by 60%+ (/cases: 156ms, /faq: 151ms, /blog: 181ms, service heroes: 0-15ms).

Description: res.json() throws SyntaxError when endpoint returns 200 HTML on static dev/preview server without content-type check
TriggerCondition: Static preview server returning index.html for /api/articles
ActionTaken: Added defensive content-type validation before json() parsing in requestArticles and fetchArticle.

Description: hasCustomCover only matched /og-image-v2.jpg; articles having legacy /og-image.jpg were falsely treated as custom covers downloading 62KB unoptimized image over 1.6Mbps mobile network
TriggerCondition: Initial render of /cases and /blog on mobile network
ActionTaken: Added DEFAULT_COVER_PATTERNS set including /og-image.jpg and /og-image.png with slash normalization.

Description: Secondary desk pieces (laptop, notebook) preloaded fetchpriority=high on mobile competing with true LCP asset desk-v-800.webp during 1.6Mbps initial stream
TriggerCondition: Initial load of /consult on mobile network
ActionTaken: Added media='not all and (max-width: 1023px)' to secondary preloads in generate-pages.js, marked secondary scene images with loading='lazy' fetchpriority='low'.

Description: LCP image for /consult was 78KB at 640x960 px; prolonged network download on 1.6Mbps connection
ActionTaken: Re-encoded and resized to 480x720 at q68 (38.7 KB), cutting download time by 50%.

Description: Colon ':' (0x3A) in Cyrillic heading matched ASCII U+0000-00FF range of commissioner-400-normal-latin.woff2 triggering an unexpected 36.1KB blocking font download
ActionTaken: Restricted Latin unicode-range in @font-face to U+0041-005A, U+0061-007A.

Description: service:meta-ads titleLines[0] contained accidental font: 'inter' causing inline style override and triggering 66KB unexpected download (inter-cyrillic 18.6KB + inter-latin 47.4KB)
ActionTaken: Stripped font: 'inter' in applyStoredSiteContentCompatibility for service:meta-ads; title inherits 'WW Prata'. LCP dropped from 2940ms to 2487ms, score jumped from 94 to 98.

Description: Prehydrate selector froze .meta-proof__item opacity at 0 on /meta-ads during first screen render
ActionTaken: Added explicit rule overriding animation and setting opacity: 1 during prehydrate state.

Description: Bundled asset imports (import from ../../assets/cases) leaked into Node SSR bundle generating SSR_ASSET_PLACEHOLDER error during generate:pages
TriggerCondition: npm run build on case article routes
ActionTaken: Replaced bundled asset imports with public paths (/images/case-*.webp), guarded prototype properties in getCaseCatalogMeta.

Description: Above-the-fold hero cover images wrapped in Framer Motion m.figure/m.div with decoding=async delaying LCP render by ~3s under CPU throttle
TriggerCondition: Mobile Lighthouse LCP measurement on article/case routes
ActionTaken: Replaced with plain static figure/div, set decoding=auto, bypassed lead animations when settledEntrance is true.

Description: Mobile media query (max-width: 560px) clamped case article h1 to 26-33px, causing 86-char title to wrap into 4 lines then collapse to 3 lines via title-fit with CLS 0.0582
TriggerCondition: Mobile load of Case 2 on 412px viewport
ActionTaken: Relaxed clamp to clamp(20px, 5.8vw, 28px), ensuring initial cascade fits 3 lines. CLS eliminated to 0.

Description: Giant 37KB stylesheet containing entire catalog and filter rules was render-blocking on case article routes
ActionTaken: Extracted case article styles into src/styles/case-article.css (19KB / 4KB gzip), cutting render-blocking CSS by 50%.

Description: Content images in article/case body requested 768px variants on mobile screens due to lack of max-width 480px rule in ARTICLE_IMAGE_SIZES.content, downloading up to 63KB per image
TriggerCondition: Mobile network bandwidth usage on blog and case routes
ActionTaken: Added (max-width: 480px) 180px rule in articleImages.ts and article-image-manifest.js, reducing content image download to 34KB (46% bandwidth reduction).

Description: Separate chunk stylesheet CaseArticleView-*.css forced mobile browser on 4G to perform second round-trip before FCP/LCP paint candidates settled
ActionTaken: Consolidated case-article.css into index.css, eliminating separate chunk stylesheet request, reducing Case 2 LCP from 3462ms to 3310ms and preserving all 14 marketing routes at 95-99.

Description: Static case covers lacked manifest variants causing test:seo-output failure when preloading raw static webp without srcset/sizes
ActionTaken: Strictly enforced SEO contract: raw local covers load via SSR HTML with fetchpriority=high and loading=eager without synthetic preloads, passing all 15 SEO checks.

Description: Unconditional emission of deprecated FAQPage structured data on articles/cases inflates HTML by 2.9KB uncompressed (1.6KB gzip)
ActionTaken: Omitted articleFaqJsonLd on case article routes in scripts/generate-pages.js:2239; FAQ rendered as interactive accordion in HTML without inflating initial payload by 1.6KB gzip.

Description: DOM duplication of article summary and keyTakeaways into separate desktop (<aside>/<section>) and mobile (<details>) markup inflates DOM by 70+ elements and adds 4KB uncompressed payload
TriggerCondition: Server-rendered HTML and client hydration on /cases/:slug
ActionTaken: Consolidated duplicate desktop and mobile summary and keyTakeaways markup in src/app/components/CaseArticleView.tsx into unified responsive containers, eliminating 70+ redundant DOM elements.

Description: Case articles 12 and 13 carry legacy image '/og-image.jpg' instead of their catalog covers, causing resolveArticleCoverPreload to skip preload discovery
ActionTaken: Aligned case articles 12 and 13 cover image metadata in public/articles.seed.json, data/articles.build.json, and data/articles.local.json with catalog covers /images/case-concierge.webp and /images/case-b2c.webp.

Description: Dual client-side DOMPurify sanitizer runs on initial load burn 80-120ms of throttled CPU evaluating articles already sanitized during SSR
TriggerCondition: Initial client mount and hydration on /cases/:slug and /blog/:slug
ActionTaken: Implemented pre-hydrated DOM adoption fast-path in src/app/pages/BlogPage.tsx:525-541, bypassing redundant dual client-side DOMPurify sanitizer runs on initial load.

Description: Secondary route-specific hero stylesheets in <head> caused second round-trip latency on simulated 4G, delaying FCP/LCP by 300-630ms on landing routes
ActionTaken: Consolidated meta-ads-editorial-hero.css, meta-apps-hero.css, consult-studio-hero.css, consult-desk-scene.css, and cosmic-hero.css into src/styles/index.css, eliminating secondary CSS chunk.

Description: Framer Motion entrance animations fired upon hydration in pre-settled SSR view, wasting CPU cycles on layout passes and ballooning TBT to 134.5ms
ActionTaken: Guarded animate and transition props in EventRow, PhoneNotification, Receipt, and root visual with reduced/settled check; TBT dropped to 12.5ms.

Description: Programmatic focus during accessibility audits and mobile touch gestures triggered route preloader downloading 150+ KB of foreign chunks
TriggerCondition: Lighthouse audit on /meta-apps loading cosmic hero assets
ActionTaken: Guarded focusin with :focus-visible check, ignored touch pointerover events, and respected navigator.connection.saveData.

Description: Below-the-fold stone pedestal and secondary stamps competed with in-viewport phone shell during initial mobile network stream
TriggerCondition: Mobile LCP and network waterfall on /meta-apps
ActionTaken: Assigned priority: true to meta-phone-3d-shell-mobile.webp, removed below-fold mobile pedestal preload, set loading=lazy on pedestal and secondary stamps.

Description: Broad unicode-range in Prata Normal Latin font triggered false-positive download of prata-400-normal-latin.woff2 on Cyrillic landing headlines
ActionTaken: Restricted unicode-range to U+0041-005A, U+0061-007A, eliminating unnecessary Latin font download.
